name: BuyWhere
description: Agent-native product catalog API for AI agent commerce: 288M+ products from 158,000+ storefronts worldwide with deliver_to delivery-location ranking and availability labels.

skills.name: Product Search
skills.description: Search 288M+ products worldwide by keyword, category, price range, merchant, country, currency, and availability; pass deliver_to for the user's delivery location to rank deliverable results first.
examples: Find espresso machines under 500 USD deliverable to Canada
Search wireless headphones under 150 EUR with deliver_to=DE and availability labels

skills.name: Delivery-Aware Product Comparison
skills.description: Compare products across global storefronts by normalized price, rating, specs, merchant, and availability for a requested delivery location.
examples: Compare iPhone 16 Pro prices available to ship to Australia
Which standing desks are deliverable to Singapore with the best normalized USD price?

skills.name: Deal Finder
skills.description: Find best deals and discounts across 158,000+ merchants worldwide, filtered or ranked by availability for the user's delivery location.
examples: Show me the best laptop deals deliverable to the United Kingdom today
Find discounted running shoes that are local or ships_to_you for deliver_to=SG

mcp.note: Use /mcp/sse for SSE clients; https://api.buywhere.ai/mcp is the canonical MCP endpoint in llms.txt and remains valid.
